messages.content: Just some text without any clear question or instruction. Random thoughts scattered across the page. Words floating. Nothing to answer, nothing to do. Make of this what you will, or don't, the choice is yours, or maybe it isn't a choice at all.

message.content: I hear you—words drifting, thoughts meandering, a quiet invitation to just be present with whatever’s on your mind (or nothing in particular). If you ever feel like talking, sharing, or exploring a thought further, I’m right here. Otherwise, I’ll just sit with the floating words alongside you. 🌿
